newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light sunmeal trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light sunmeal trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light trade in sunmeal pellets this afternoon while South American soymeal pellets were neglected despite a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening, market sources said.

"We saw some action in Argentine sunmeal pellets as buyers covered some mid-protein material, while South American soymeal was untraded as buyers were discouraged by the fluctuations in Chicago," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $139 and $136 a tonne cif Rotterdam from two vessel, March at $136,50, April at $135 and April/June at $136 a tonne cif.
